privacy_openai_body: If you use the CV Assistant, your question and bounded chat history are sent to the OpenAI API to generate an answer. The application uses the Responses API with store=false and a pseudonymous safety identifier; it does not send the raw client IP as that identifier. OpenAI states that API data is not used to train its models unless the customer opts in, while default abuse-monitoring logs may contain prompts and responses for up to 30 days.
privacy_turnstile_body: Turnstile is used when you enter the assistant or verify protected contact details. Cloudflare processes security and browser/network signals to distinguish people from automated traffic and states that Turnstile does not access, store or transmit form entries or user communications.
privacy_analytics_body: Cloudflare Web Analytics is enabled for aggregate page and performance measurement. Cloudflare states that Web Analytics does not collect or use visitors' personal data.
privacy_local_body: The assistant reports its active local chat-retention setting to the browser. The privacy-minimizing source default is 0 days, so completed question/answer text is not stored locally. Pseudonymous rate-limit timestamps and aggregate daily counters remain for abuse control. Operational Telegram notifications use a pseudonymous interaction identifier by default and do not include question/answer text. The protected phone number is returned only after successful Turnstile verification and is not embedded in the static site.
privacy_basis_body: Where these operations involve personal data, the legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR: the legitimate interests in operating a secure public portfolio, answering optional CV questions and preventing abuse. OpenAI's DPA states that EEA/Swiss data is handled under OpenAI Ireland Ltd. and onward transfers use SCCs or an adequacy decision. No special OpenAI zero-retention or EU-residency account feature is claimed.
privacy_rights_body: Where GDPR applies, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction or object to processing, and you may lodge a complaint with a competent data-protection authority. Use andris@rozkalns.net for privacy requests.
